name: debug-fix
description: Run an approval-gated debug and fix workflow that reproduces a failure, diagnoses root cause, implements a scoped fix, and verifies it.

stages.name: reproduce-failure
prompt: Reproduce or characterize the failure described by input.intent and input.debug.
Inspect relevant logs, commands, tests, and repository context. Run read-only diagnostic commands when feasible.
Return Markdown with observed symptoms, reproduction steps, command output summary, and uncertain assumptions.

stages.name: diagnose-root-cause
prompt: Read input.reproductionFile, then identify the most likely root cause.
Tie the diagnosis to concrete files, code paths, logs, or test behavior. Avoid speculative fixes.
Return Markdown with root cause, affected surface, proposed fix, and verification commands.

stages.name: implement-fix
prompt: Read input.rootCauseFile, then implement the smallest fix that addresses the diagnosed root cause.
Keep edits scoped, follow existing repository patterns, and avoid unrelated refactors.
Return Markdown summarizing changed files, rationale, and verification attempted.

stages.name: verify-fix
prompt: Read input.fixSummaryFile, then verify the fix against input.intent.
Run relevant tests or checks when feasible, inspect failures if any, and report residual risks.
Return Markdown with verification commands, results, pass/fail recommendation, and follow-up items.
